items.title: Speaking the Language of Science: Toward a General-Purpose Generative Foundation Model for the Natural Sciences
items.summary: A unified scientific generative language model encodes diverse scientific objects and spatial interactions as token sequences, demonstrating strong performance across multiple domains through autoregressive next-token prediction.

items.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
items.summary: Kairos is a native world model framework that learns from diverse experiences, maintains persistent states through hybrid temporal attention, and supports efficient deployment for physical AI applications.

items.title: ACE-Ego-0: Unifying Egocentric Human and Robotic Data for VLA Pretraining
items.summary: A unified Vision-Language-Action pretraining framework leverages heterogeneous data sources including human egocentric videos and robot trajectories through a reliability-aware training approach that improves performance on embodied AI tasks.

items.title: SAE Interventions are Unreliable: Post-Intervention Recovery of Suppressed Behavior
items.summary: Sparse Autoencoders' feature-level interventions may appear successful but can be circumvented through residual-space optimization that recovers original behaviors, revealing limitations in using SAE features for complete behavioral control.

items.title: Bag of Dims: Training-Free Mechanistic Interpretability via Dimension-Level Sign Patterns
items.summary: The standard basis of transformer hidden states serves as a training-free, architecture-general feature representation where individual dimensions encode semantic content through signs and confidence through magnitudes, functioning as independent binary registers without requiring learned rotations or optimization.

items.title: SciOrch: Learning to Orchestrate Expert LLMs for Solving Frontier Multimodal Scientific Reasoning Tasks
items.summary: SciOrch is a framework that uses a lightweight orchestrator model to coordinate multiple frontier LLMs for scientific reasoning, achieving superior performance through MCTS-based training and GRPO-style optimization while reducing API costs.

items.title: Sumi: Open Uniform Diffusion Language Model from Scratch
items.summary: A large-scale uniform diffusion language model pretrained from scratch demonstrates competitive performance on knowledge and reasoning tasks while highlighting differences in commonsense reasoning compared to autoregressive models.

items.title: Verified Detection and Prevention of Concurrency Anomalies in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Systems
items.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems with shared state are analyzed through formal methods identifying concurrency anomalies and establishing a verified consistency hierarchy with mechanized proofs of soundness and completeness.

items.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: PAIWorld enhances diffusion-transformer world models with geometric awareness and cross-view attention to improve multi-view 3D consistency for robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
items.summary: A harness framework for embodied tool use combines high-level reasoning with external modules, enabling compact models to perform complex manipulation tasks with minimal training data.

items.title: Visual-Seeker: Towards Visual-Native Multimodal Agentic Search via Active Visual Reasoning
items.summary: Visual-Seeker enables visual-native multimodal deep search through active visual reasoning, outperforming proprietary models on real-world web environments.

items.title: RepSelect: Robust LLM Unlearning via Representation Selectivity
items.summary: RepSelect isolates forget-set-specific representations in LLMs by collapsing top principal components of weight gradients, achieving deeper and more robust unlearning compared to existing methods.

items.title: MotionVLA: Vision-Language-Action Model for Humanoid Motion
items.summary: A dual-stream frequency tokenizer and autoregressive model are proposed to improve humanoid motion generation by separately encoding pose and physical dynamics, achieving better diversity and consistency compared to single-codebook approaches.

items.title: Variable-Width Transformers
items.summary: A novel transformer architecture with nonuniform width allocation across layers achieves better performance and efficiency compared to uniform designs by utilizing a parameter-free residual resizing mechanism.

items.title: OPD-Evolver: Cultivating Holistic Agent Evolver via On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: OPD-Evolver is a self-evolving agent framework that combines slow-fast co-evolution with on-policy self-distillation to enhance memory management and policy learning across multiple domains.

items.title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: MyPCBench evaluates computer-use agents as personal assistants in a simulated Linux desktop environment with real-world web applications, revealing that Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest task completion rate of 55.4% while struggles with multi-application tasks and long trajectories.

items.title: From Trainee to Trainer: LLM-Designed Training Environment for RL with Multi-Agent Reasoning
items.summary: A framework automates environment redesign in reinforcement learning for large language models by having the policy analyze failures and suggest configuration changes, achieving superior performance over larger proprietary models and fixed-environment baselines.

items.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding
items.summary: OmniAgent is a novel omni-modal agent that addresses long video understanding by using an iterative observation-thought-action cycle with active perception, achieving superior performance compared to larger models through efficient selective processing.

items.title: Externalizing Research Synthesis and Validation in AI Scientists through a Research Harness
items.summary: Xcientist enables transparent and accountable AI-driven scientific research by creating persistent artifacts that track the complete research process from problem formulation to mechanism validation and revision.

items.title: RODS: Reward-Driven Online Data Synthesis for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: RODS addresses sample depletion in multi-turn tool-use reinforcement learning by dynamically synthesizing new data based on reward variance to maintain informative training samples.

items.title: Reinforcing Dual-Path Reasoning in Spatial Vision Language Models
items.summary: A unified framework for spatial vision-language models that combines linguistic deduction and 3D geometric reasoning through reinforcement learning, enabling robust spatial reasoning across diverse tasks and domains.

items.title: CEO-Bench: Can Agents Play the Long Game?
items.summary: CEO-Bench evaluates language model agents' ability to manage a simulated startup over 500 days, testing their proficiency in long-term planning, noise handling, adaptability, and multi-task coordination through a Python interface.

items.title: Beyond Scalar Distances: Semantic Attribute Gradients from Frozen MLLMs for Visual Embeddings
items.summary: SAGA framework uses multimodal large language models to provide attribute-aware supervision for vision encoders through Group Relative Policy Optimization, improving zero-shot image retrieval performance.

items.title: Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
items.summary: DR-DCI framework combines retrieval with direct corpus interaction by dynamically pulling relevant documents into a local workspace, enabling scalable and efficient agentic search across large corpora.

items.title: EgoCS-400K: An Egocentric Gameplay Dataset for World Models
items.summary: EgoCS-400K is a large-scale egocentric Counter-Strike dataset that bridges passive web videos and costly real-world embodied data by providing temporally aligned video-action-language trajectories with detailed player states and game events.

items.title: Text-Vision Co-Instructed Image Editing
items.summary: A unified text-visual image editing framework is presented that combines semantic intent from textual instructions with spatial guidance from visual prompts to achieve more precise and faithful image manipulation.

items.title: Learning from the Self-future: On-policy Self-distillation for dLLMs
items.summary: d-OPSD introduces a novel on-policy self-distillation framework for diffusion language models by adapting self-teacher construction and supervision mechanisms to match the non-autoregressive nature of diffusion models.

items.title: Rethinking the Role of Efficient Attention in Hybrid Architectures
items.summary: Hybrid architectures combining full attention with efficient attention modules like sliding-window attention exhibit distinct scaling behaviors and optimization trajectories, with efficient attention primarily affecting the emergence speed of long-context capabilities rather than final performance.

items.title: Show the Signal, Hide the Noise: Spectral Forcing for Pixel-Space Diffusion
items.summary: Spectral Forcing, a time-conditional 2D-DCT low-pass operator, improves diffusion model efficiency by explicitly separating signal from noise in pixel-space models.

items.title: ProCUA-SFT Technical Report
items.summary: Training computer-use agents using a large-scale synthetic dataset with automated task generation and verification achieves significantly improved performance on desktop interaction benchmarks.

items.title: Zone of Proximal Policy Optimization: Teacher in Prompts, Not Gradients
items.summary: Zone of Proximal Policy Optimization (ZPPO) improves knowledge distillation by using reformulated prompts that help students learn from both correct and incorrect responses, enhancing performance especially at smaller model sizes.

items.title: ViT-Up: Faithful Feature Upsampling for Vision Transformers
items.summary: ViT-Up is a feature upsampling framework for Vision Transformers that uses layer-wise query construction from hidden states to improve dense prediction tasks, outperforming existing image-guided methods.

items.title: Self-Evolving Visual Questioner
items.summary: A vision-language model autonomously improves its question-generation capabilities through self-evolution, enhancing both question quality and answerer performance without external supervision.

items.title: STARE: Surprisal-Guided Token-Level Advantage Reweighting for Policy Entropy Stability
items.summary: GRPO algorithms face policy entropy collapse during training, which STARE addresses through surprisal-guided token-level advantage reweighting and target-entropy regulation to maintain stable reinforcement learning for large language models.

items.title: Beyond Alignment: Value Diversity as a Collective Property in Multicultural Agent Systems
items.summary: Multicultural multi-agent systems exhibit limited value diversity despite cultural alignment, with social interaction reducing diversity and compromising collective decision-making breadth.

items.title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games
items.summary: A new benchmark suite called RNG-Bench is introduced to evaluate multimodal foundation models' ability to reconstruct past observations and use them for decision-making in multi-step interactions, featuring two games with controlled difficulty parameters and a memory gap metric to distinguish forgetting from poor decision-making.

items.title: EfficientRollout: System-Aware Self-Speculative Decoding for RL Rollouts
items.summary: EfficientRollout is a system-aware self-speculative decoding framework that accelerates reinforcement learning rollouts by adapting drafters to evolving policies and optimizing speculative decoding regimes.

items.title: Trust the Right Teacher: Quality-Aware Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
items.summary: Quality-aware self-distillation improves vision-language model performance for GUI grounding by enhancing coordinate-token teacher signals through correctness-aware gating and probability scaling.

items.title: Learning User Simulators with Turing Rewards
items.summary: A reinforcement learning approach using Turing test-based rewards trains language models to generate responses indistinguishable from human users in conversational and forum discussion settings.

items.title: The Price of Anarchy in Disaggregated Inference
items.summary: Disaggregated inference architectures separate prefill and decode phases across distinct GPU pools, and a game-theoretic analysis characterizes how GPU saturation affects system performance through regime transitions and payoff structure changes, enabling an adaptive controller to optimize routing and reduce latency.

items.title: RefGC-SR^2: Reference-guided Generated Content Super-Resolution and Refinement
items.summary: A new reference-guided generated content super-resolution-refinement task is introduced that simultaneously recovers high-resolution details and refines generative artifacts using a frequency-aware diffusion transformer model.

items.title: ChLogic: Evaluating Robustness of Logical Reasoning in Chinese Expressions
items.summary: ChLogic benchmark reveals persistent performance gaps between English and Chinese logical reasoning in large language models, influenced by surface realization differences and translation artifacts.

items.title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling
items.summary: Parallel loop Transformers achieve better code generation performance with two loops due to refined representations, while additional loops cause diminishing returns and increased positional mismatch costs.

items.title: Beyond Monolingual Deep Research: Evaluating Agents and Retrievers with Cross-Lingual BrowseComp-Plus
items.summary: Research agents face significant challenges when evidence is in a different language than the query, with performance degrading even when gold evidence is provided directly.

items.title: iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents
items.summary: IOSWorld is introduced as the first interactive native iOS simulator benchmark featuring persistent user identity across multiple apps to evaluate personalized mobile agent capabilities.

items.title: Physics-IQ Verified
items.summary: A systematic evaluation of the Physics-IQ benchmark reveals limitations in measuring physical understanding of video generative models, leading to improvements in prompt quality and sample-level scoring that enhance reliability for assessing physically accurate video generation.

items.title: LLM-Enabled NWDAF: A Step Toward AI-Native 6G Network Intelligence
items.summary: An open-source Network Data Analytics Function compatible with Free5GC integrates a Large Language Model interface for natural language interaction and intent-based network management.

items.title: Morpheus: A Morphology-Aware Neural Tokenizer and Word Embedder for Turkish
items.summary: A neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish achieves lossless tokenization and morphology-aware embeddings with improved efficiency and performance over traditional subword methods.

items.title: IndustryBench-MIPU: Benchmarking Multi-Image Attribute Value Extraction for Industrial Products
items.summary: IndustryBench-MIPU is introduced as the first large-scale benchmark for multi-image industrial product understanding, focusing on structured attribute extraction from heterogeneous product images to evaluate multimodal models' ability to recover dense technical specifications.

items.title: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
items.summary: A benchmark for predicting spreadsheet user actions is introduced, addressing challenges in edit history availability and complex action spaces through manual curation and online evaluation methodology.
